actualFactClaims.reason: Filing describes the Company as 'a leading AI company in China, dedicated to developing general-purpose large models'; 'AI-model developer Z.AI' in P002 is an accurate plain restatement.

Placing net proceeds ~HK$15,664.13M plus bond net proceeds ~US$3,010.77M (~HK$23,610.24M) total ~HK$39.3B ≈ US$5.0B; both transactions are explicitly conditional ('may or may not proceed'/'may or may not be issued'), matching P002's 'conditional... roughly US$5 billion'.

Use of Proceeds states 'Approximately 60% of the net proceeds will be used for the R&D of the Company's next-generation GLM foundation models and its Fully Self Training system, as well as the deployment and upgrade of... computing resources and related technology infrastructure', matching P002 exactly.

Filing: placing agents procure placees, professional/institutional investors, 'to subscribe for up to 21,965,000 new H Shares' at the Placing Price; P003's gloss 'selling newly issued shares to investors' is a faithful plain-language rendering.
The Bonds are zero coupon convertible bonds with a Conversion Right to convert into new H Shares at HK$892.50 initial Conversion Price; P003's 'borrowing that can later become shares' is accurate.

Filing states 'The Placing and the issue of the Bonds are independent of each other and are not inter-conditional' and lists distinct conditions precedent for each, supporting P003's 'separate completion conditions'.

Definitions section: 'Fully Self Training — the Group's technical vision that the next generation of GLM models will be trained in environments built by the previous generation of GLM models', matching P004 including the 'explicitly a technical vision' framing.

Use of Proceeds lists data self-generation, task-environment self-generation and infrastructure self-optimization ('intends to leverage the models' capabilities... to assist in developing and optimizing... training and inference systems'), matching P004's three activities.

Data self-generation passage lists 'rule-based verification, execution verification, model review and manual spot-checking'; P004's 'proposed checks include manual spot-checking' is directly supported and correctly framed as proposed.

The filing frames everything as intent ('intends to explore a technical loop') and discloses financing conditions; it contains no measured self-improvement result, so P005's negative claim that it does not demonstrate self-improvement or change today's chatbot is accurate.
